player.help_body:
1. Start listening
• No music shown? Click Add a folder to scan your local library, or start a track from the Folders or Playlists tabs.

2. Control playback
• Use the central buttons to Play / Pause, Stop, or go to the Previous / Next track.
• Click directly on the progress bar to move within the track.
• Enable shuffle (🔀) or repeat (🔁: whole list or single track).
• Hover the Next button (⏭) to preview the next track in the "Up next" bar (click it to jump there immediately).

3. Customize sound and ambiance
• At the top: adjust the volume (🔊) and choose an animated visual effect for the background.
• Bottom right (⚙): open the quick audio tools (sound output, equalizer, transitions, sleep timer).
audio_tools.buffer_only_hint: Only available with the Audio Buffer engine.
settings.sound_processing_desc: Reguleeri ReplayGain normaliseerimist ja toitluskiirust (väike puffer ainult).
blind_test.help_body:
1. Start a game
• First load a playlist or a selection of tracks from Tracks, Folders or Playlists, then start the round.

2. How a round works
• The excerpt starts automatically with the information and cover art hidden.
• Click Reveal at any time to show the title, artist and cover.
• Use Next to move on to the next track (with a configurable fade).

3. Customization
• Adjust the volume and the visual effect at the top of the window.
• Set the guessing and reveal durations in Settings › Player.
playlist.help_body:
1. Organize your playlists
• Create, rename or delete playlists from the left bar or the context menu.
• Use the active queue to view and reorder the tracks being played.

2. Add and reorder tracks
• Drag and drop tracks to change their order.
• Double-click a track to start playing it immediately.

3. Export or share
• Save your playlists in standard formats (M3U / PLS) to reuse them elsewhere.
tracks.help_body:
1. Search and filter
• Use the search bar at the top to instantly filter by title, artist, album or file.
• Click the column headers to sort, or right-click to choose which columns are displayed.

2. Quick actions
• Double-click a track to play it.
• Right-click a selection to add it to the queue or to a playlist, or to edit its properties.

3. Duplicates view
• From the sidebar, the Duplicates entry analyzes the tracks in your active playlist.
duplicates.help_body:
The duplicate search only covers tracks in your active playlist.

1. Load the tracks to analyze
• Go to Folders or Tracks and add the tracks or folders to check to the Playlist.

2. Identify copies
• Come back to Duplicates: AMSO automatically detects identical files (fingerprint) or similar ones (metadata) within this list.

3. Compare and clean up
• Filter with the search bar or sort by columns (duration, size, folder) to spot the extra copies.
• Right-click a track to remove or delete it.
folders.help_body:
1. Navigate the tree
• On the left, browse your local or remote sources folder by folder.
• Select a folder to display its tracks in the table on the right.

2. Play and organize
• Double-click a track to start playing the folder.
• The built-in mini-player at the top lets you control playback without leaving the explorer.

3. Trash
• Files deleted from AMSO stay available in the Trash at the bottom of the tree for restoration or permanent deletion.
library_sources.help_body:
1. Add folders or sources
• Click Add a folder (or a remote source) to add it to your AMSO library.

2. Scan and synchronize
• Start a scan to detect new files, update metadata and fetch cover art.
• Enable automatic monitoring if you want AMSO to detect your additions in real time.

3. Clean up
• You can disable or remove a source at any time without deleting your files from the disk.
settings.general_help_body:
1. Language and interface
• Choose the application language (applied immediately across the whole interface).
• Customize the startup behavior and the system notification area (tray).

2. Shortcuts and system
• Configure automatic update handling and desktop integration options.
settings.sound_help_body:
1. Audio engine and output
• Choose between the continuous buffer engine (recommended for crossfade, the equalizer and ReplayGain) and VLC Direct.
• Select your audio output device.

2. Equalizer and processing
• Enable ReplayGain normalization to even out the volume between your tracks.
• Adjust the playback speed or the equalizer bands to your liking.
settings.player_help_body:
1. Transitions between tracks
• Choose the transition mode: Standard, Gapless (0 ms) or Crossfade with an adjustable duration.

2. Display and cover art
• Customize the information shown in the large player and the "Up next" bar.

3. Blind Test settings
• Set the durations of the guessing and reveal phases as well as the fade-out.
settings.effects_help_body:
1. Choose the available effects
• Enable or customize the background animations shown in the Player and the Blind Test (audio spectrum, particles, waves, etc.).

2. Performance
• Adjust smoothness or visual sensitivity according to your machine's capabilities.
logs.help_body:
1. Follow the activity
• Browse the history of scans, playback, any errors and library operations.

2. Filter and export
• Filter entries by level (Information, Warning, Error) or search for a specific message.
• Use the export button or the one that opens the logs folder to share a diagnosis.
settings.about_help_body:
1. Version information
• Find the current AMSO version number, the status of the audio components (LibVLC, buffer engine) and the credits.

2. Updates and support
• Manually check whether a new version is available or browse the project documentation.
